modules.title: 新风险出现后，产品待办列表怎样重新排序
产品待办列表怎样支持持续取舍

items.title: 收纳不同类型的候选工作
items.text: 功能、缺陷、体验改进和必要技术工作都可以进入列表，但每项都要能说明它与产品目标的关系。

items.title: 用顺序表达当前判断
items.text: 排序综合价值、风险、依赖和证据，不是给每项贴一个永远不变的高、中、低标签。

items.title: 越靠近实施越具体
items.text: 近期条目需要清楚的范围和完成条件，远期想法可以等待更多信息后再拆分和估算。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:product-backlog} 保存并排列候选工作；{c:product-roadmap} 解释一段时间内的目标和方向；{c:gantt-chart} 才把已经选定的任务放到具体时间轴上。待办列表中的条目不自动等于交付承诺。

lessonPractice.title: 支付故障影响所有订单，同时团队收到一个地图配色建议。怎样更新产品待办列表更合理？

options.label: 核对影响后把支付故障移到前面并补充验收条件，配色建议保留在后面等待更多证据
options.feedback: 对。列表顺序可以根据风险和证据调整；近期条目需要更清楚，较远的想法可以先保留必要信息。

options.label: 所有新内容只按收到时间追加，原有顺序永远不变
options.feedback: 产品待办列表是动态的。新风险和证据出现后仍保持旧顺序，会让列表失去决策作用。

options.label: 给列表里的每一项确定发布日期，并立即向用户承诺全部实现
options.feedback: 进入待办列表只表示该项被记录和考虑，不等于已经承诺范围或日期。

en.title: A payment failure affects every order, while the team also receives a map-color suggestion. How should the product backlog change?

options.label: Verify the impact, move the payment failure upward with clearer acceptance conditions, and keep the color idea lower while gathering evidence
options.feedback: Correct. The order can change with risk and evidence. Near-term items need more clarity than distant ideas.

options.label: Append every new item by arrival time and never change the existing order
options.feedback: A product backlog is dynamic. Keeping the old order after new risk appears removes its decision value.

options.label: Assign a release date to every item and promise that all of them will ship
options.feedback: Being in the backlog means an item is considered, not that its scope or release date is committed.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这批功能、缺陷和改进建议整理成产品待办列表。根据我提供的产品目标、用户影响、风险和证据提出顺序，并分别说明理由；没有数据的判断标成假设。靠前条目补充问题、范围和验收条件，较远条目保持简洁。先给排序建议，不要自行承诺发布日期或删除低优先级内容。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Organize these features, defects, and improvements into a product backlog. Propose an order using the product goal, user impact, risk, and evidence I provide, and explain each choice. Mark unsupported judgments as assumptions. Add the problem, scope, and acceptance conditions to near-term items while keeping distant items brief. Recommend the order without promising dates or deleting lower items.

learning.assumes: You have features, defects, improvements, and technical work competing for attention.
learning.outcome: You can maintain an ordered, evolving, progressively refined product backlog and distinguish it from a roadmap or current delivery plan.

modules.title: Reorder a product backlog when a new risk appears
How a product backlog supports ongoing choices

items.title: Collect different kinds of candidate work
items.text: Features, defects, experience improvements, and necessary technical work can all enter the list.

items.title: Use order to express the current judgment
items.text: Order reflects value, risk, dependencies, and evidence rather than a permanent priority label.

items.title: Add detail as work gets closer
items.text: Near-term items need clear scope and completion conditions; distant ideas can wait for more evidence.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A {c:product-backlog} orders candidate work, a {c:product-roadmap} communicates goals and direction, and a {c:gantt-chart} schedules selected tasks. A backlog item is not automatically a delivery commitment.
